verdict.rationale: Vercel documents managing local, preview, production, and custom environments and their variables. It also offers access tokens scoped to account, team, or project, and IdP-based protection for internal apps and deployments, which covers parts of centralized access and configuration. However, the evidence never shows team-wide (shared across projects) environment variables, a dedicated secrets store, or team member role/permission management, so the 'central, team-level' core is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: team-level shared env vars/secrets, member role/RBAC management docs, secret encryption/rotation details, independent hands-on corroboration.
